review.summary: Audit of the dityrosine (DITY) parameter translation, local 40-atom patch graph, and 21-residue N-telopeptide context confirms that the local topological counts (40 atoms, 41 bonds, 66 angles, 98 proper torsions), zero net side-chain charge (0.0 e per patched pair; -1.0 e full peptide), and CHARMM-to-OpenMM unit conversions in DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json are arithmetically exact. Separating CGenFF penalty annotations from actual implementation errors reveals that the 51.1 penalty and other OG312 entries in PARAMETER_AUDIT.json belong to uninstantiated DOPA-dianion parameters from the source file, whereas the active 41.1 and 30.0 penalties apply to intra-ring 2-fold planarity terms around 1CZ-1CE2 (CA-CG2R67) rather than the central inter-ring 1CE2-2CE2 (CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA) rotor, which inherited an unpenalized generic biphenyl 2-fold cosine without ortho-hydroxyl n=1/n=3 terms. However, three concrete validity threats affect the dityrosine model: (1) DITY_LINKED.json starts from unlinked DITY_CONTROL coordinates where 1CE2 and 2CE2 are 8.630 A apart and closes the bond via backbone-restrained Cartesian minimization, trapping strain in the formed link; (2) the custom charmm36_dity.xml setup lacked a two-parser energy/force cross-check analogous to the GromacsTopFile check run for glucosepane; and (3) the intramolecular i, i+2 (Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6) single-chain context fixes the C-alpha marker near 7.1 A by backbone covalent geometry while using an anisotropic ~9.5 x 3.8 x 3.3 nm box that cannot support longer unrestrained rotational tumbling.

findings.title: DITY_LINKED starts with an 8.630 A crosslink bond closed by backbone-restrained Cartesian minimization
findings.evidence: DITY_LINKED.json uses the exact initial atomic coordinates of DITY_CONTROL.json (with 1HE2 and 2HE2 deleted) while adding bond [51, 78] between Tyr4:CE2 ([1.510, -13.336, -25.377] A) and Tyr6:CE2 ([-1.705, -12.204, -17.448] A), producing an initial 1CE2-2CE2 distance of 8.630 A (5.79x the 1.490 A equilibrium length). In candidate/candidate_pilot.py (lines 68-74), LocalEnergyMinimizer pulls this 8.630 A bond closed while harmonic restraints (k = 1000 kJ/mol/nm^2) pin all backbone N, CA, C, O atoms to the unlinked pose.
findings.implication: Pulling two phenol rings across an 8.630 A gap without prior rotamer/backbone conformational search traps the Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 macrocycle in a strained local minimum, consistent with the persistently stretched mean 1CE2-2CE2 bond length of 1.5090 A vs r0 = 1.490 A (candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md, line 41) and 0.128437 A peak bond deviation (line 45).
findings.recommended_check: Generate initial DITY_LINKED coordinates via unrestrained side-chain/loop conformational sampling (scanning Tyr4/Tyr6 chi1, chi2 and Gly5 phi, psi) until the pre-minimization 1CE2-2CE2 distance is <= 1.65 A and ring out-of-plane distortion is < 5 deg before applying backbone restraints or solvating.

findings.title: CGenFF penalties 41.1 and 30.0 govern intra-ring planarity, while the central inter-ring rotor uses generic biphenyl terms
findings.evidence: Of the 10 CGenFF penalty annotations in PARAMETER_AUDIT.json (lines 72-113), four OG312 rules (including penalty 51.1 at line 98) come from deprotonated G_dopxdianion_G.str and are absent from neutral DITY, and CG2R67-CA-CA-OH1 (line 110; DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json, line 426) is a DOPA rule with no matching 4-atom path in DITY. The two active elevated penalties—41.1 for OH1-CA-CG2R67-CG2R67 (line 90, 1OH-1CZ-1CE2-2CE2) and 30.0 for OH1-CA-CG2R67-CA (line 94, 1OH-1CZ-1CE2-1CD2)—rotate around the intra-ring 1CZ-1CE2 (CA-CG2R67) bond (n = 2, phase = 180 deg). Meanwhile, the actual inter-ring crosslink torsion CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA (DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json, line 325, k = 3.72376 kJ/mol, n = 2, phase = 180 deg) carries zero CGenFF penalty only because it copies unsubstituted biphenyl.
findings.implication: The CGenFF penalty annotations are uncertainty flags rather than translation bugs, but focusing only on penalties 30 and 41.1 misses the physical parameterization issue: the central 1CE2-2CE2 rotor (CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA) lacks n = 1 and n = 3 Fourier terms needed to represent 2,2'-biphenol ortho-OH steric clash and intramolecular OH...OH hydrogen-bonding asymmetry.
findings.recommended_check: Perform a 1D/2D QM torsion benchmark on a 2,2'-biphenol / capped-dityrosine model scanning the central C_zeta1-C_epsilon2,1-C_epsilon2,2-C_zeta2 dihedral (0 to 360 deg in 15 deg steps) and coupled C_epsilon2-C_zeta-O_eta-H_eta rotamers, fitting n = 1, 2, 3, 4 cosine terms for CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA while checking that the penalty-41.1/30.0 terms keep bridgehead out-of-plane wagging within <= 3 deg of QM geometries.

findings.title: No independent CHARMM parser cross-check was executed for the patched charmm36_dity.xml topology
findings.evidence: Whereas GLU_CONTROL and GLU_LINKED are cross-checked against openmm.app.GromacsTopFile (lines 81-85), DITY_CONTROL and DITY_LINKED set cross=None (line 80) and only compare OpenMM Reference vs CUDA on the identical serialized XML System (line 75). Although the 19 bonded conversions and CG2R67 LJ parameters in DITY_TRANSLATION_AUDIT.json (lines 5-454) are arithmetically exact, full-context patch application (1-4 nonbonded exclusions/scalings across 1CE2-2CE2, 22 CMAP terms, and backbone impropers) relies on a single XML code path.
findings.implication: Any discrepancy in how OpenMM's XML residue template/patch matcher generates 1-4 exceptions or improper ordering across the inter-residue 1CE2-2CE2 bond would pass the Reference/CUDA check undetected.
findings.recommended_check: Using openmm.app.CharmmPsfFile and CharmmParameterSet (already present in the locked OpenMM wheel), load the native CHARMM .psf/.prm/.str build of the 21-residue DITY_LINKED peptide and require single-point Reference energy agreement < 1e-5 kJ/mol/atom and force RMS < 1e-2 kJ/mol/nm against charmm36_dity.xml.

findings.title: Intramolecular i, i+2 (Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6) link and anisotropic box geometry confound the C-alpha marker and longer unrestrained runs
findings.evidence: DITY_LINKED links Tyr4 and Tyr6 separated by a single residue (Gly5) on one chain, where the covalent backbone already holds C-alpha(Tyr4)-C-alpha(Tyr6) at 7.291 A initially and 7.1590 +/- 0.0616 A in DITY_CONTROL vs 7.0470 +/- 0.0733 A in DITY_LINKED (lines 40-41). In addition, candidate/candidate_pilot.py (lines 110-116) aligns the 7.10 nm extended peptide along principal axes with a +2.4 nm buffer per axis, yielding an anisotropic ~9.5 x 3.8 x 3.3 nm^3 box (~118 nm^3 from the 0.140929 M salt concentration at line 18).
findings.implication: The C-alpha(Tyr4)-C-alpha(Tyr6) distance is structurally clamped by the intervening Gly5 backbone and cannot resolve crosslink mechanical stiffening; moreover, extending unrestrained MD beyond 30 ps in the ~3.3-3.8 nm transverse box will allow rotational tumbling of the 7.10 nm peptide into its periodic image.
findings.recommended_check: Compare an intermolecular two-chain dityrosine model (or track end-to-end telopeptide extension and ring-ring distances rather than i, i+2 C-alpha distance) and solvate in a padded cubic/dodecahedral box (>= 9.5 nm on all axes) or apply weak terminal C-alpha orientational anchors when running longer unrestrained trajectories.

findings.title: Runtime geometry checks omit sp2 bridgehead planarity, inter-ring torsion distributions, and heavy-atom bond strain
findings.evidence: The stereocenter tracker centers(d) (line 47) filters strictly for 4-coordinate sp3 carbons (len(ns)==4), monitoring 20 tetrahedral centers in DITY while ignoring sp2 planarity at 1CE2, 2CE2 (CG2R67) and 1CZ, 2CZ (CA). During MD (lines 155-157), only X-H constraint errors are checked per chunk; neither the inter-ring dihedral (1CZ-1CE2-2CE2-2CZ), bridgehead out-of-plane angles, nor the 1CE2-2CE2 bond length time series are output to NUMERIC_READBACK.json.
findings.implication: Because DITY_LINKED was minimized from an 8.630 A initial bond, unmonitored sp2 out-of-plane pyramidalization at 1CE2/2CE2 or trapped high-energy biphenyl torsion states could persist throughout the 30-ps unrestrained window without triggering any runtime gate.
findings.recommended_check: Add deterministic trajectory readbacks for (1) the central inter-ring torsion psi_link (1CZ-1CE2-2CE2-2CZ), (2) out-of-plane improper angles at 1CE2, 2CE2, 1CZ, and 2CZ, (3) Tyr4/Tyr6 (chi1, chi2) and Gly5 (phi, psi) dihedrals, and (4) the 1CE2-2CE2 bond length distribution across all saved frames in solute_frames_nm.npy.

review.strongest_surviving_claim: The local 40-atom DITY patch graph (41 bonds, 66 angles, 98 proper torsions, 0.0 e net side-chain charge, and -1.0 e full-peptide charge) and all 19 bonded and Lennard-Jones unit translations from the source CHARMM/CGenFF stream/parameter archive into OpenMM XML are arithmetically exact, and all six DITY_CONTROL and DITY_LINKED 50-ps trajectories completed in mixed precision with verified Reference/CUDA agreement and stable constraints.
review.decisive_next_experiment: Priority 1 (Offline trajectory readback on existing solute_frames_nm.npy): Compute the time series and distributions of the central crosslink bond length r(1CE2-2CE2), inter-ring dihedral psi_link (1CZ-1CE2-2CE2-2CZ), bridgehead sp2 out-of-plane improper angles at 1CE2/2CE2/1CZ/2CZ, and Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 (chi1, chi2, phi, psi) angles across the existing 3 x 50 ps DITY_LINKED and DITY_CONTROL runs. Priority 2 (Parser cross-check): Verify charmm36_dity.xml single-point energy and forces on DITY_LINKED against openmm.app.CharmmPsfFile/CharmmParameterSet loaded directly from the source CHARMM .psf/.prm/.str files (stop criterion: energy difference < 1e-5 kJ/mol/atom and force RMS < 1e-2 kJ/mol/nm). Priority 3 (QM torsion/geometry validation and rotamer-relaxed rebuild): Run a constrained QM torsion scan (e.g., revDSD-PBEP86-D3BJ or MP2/def2-TZVP // B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP in implicit water) on a 2,2'-biphenol / capped-dityrosine dimer over psi_link in 15 deg increments for cis/trans OH rotamers; refit CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA (n = 1..4) and check penalty-41.1/30.0 out-of-plane terms. Rebuild DITY_LINKED by pre-relaxing Tyr4/Tyr6 rotamers so initial r(1CE2-2CE2) <= 1.65 A before backbone-restrained minimization. Convergence/stop criteria: QM vs MM torsion profile RMSE <= 2.0 kJ/mol across all minima/barriers within 25 kJ/mol of the global minimum, equilibrium MM mean bond length |<r(1CE2-2CE2)> - 1.490 A| <= 0.008 A, and sp2 out-of-plane angle RMS < 4 deg. Falsifier: If pre-relaxed rotamer initialization plus QM-refitted inter-ring torsions still yield a strained 1CE2-2CE2 bond (> 1.505 A) or > 10 deg sp2 ring distortion in the Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 N-telopeptide, reject the intramolecular i, i+2 Tyr4-Tyr6 crosslink hypothesis in favor of an intermolecular dityrosine model.
